metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 2017 · Site Unseen: An Emma Fielding Mystery
metas.description: Archaeology Professor Emma Fielding seeks evidence of a 17-century Maine settlement predating Jamestown. But a dead body she uncovers leads her to a present-day investigation into a murder.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 2018 · Past Malice: An Emma Fielding Mystery
metas.description: When Professor Emma Fielding's colleague is found murdered in Chandler Castle's crypt, an age-old curse soon enwraps Emma, her students and FBI Agent Conner.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.4 · 2019 · Emma Fielding Mysteries: More Bitter Than Death
metas.description: Boxes for Kenzer College are lit on fire on a truck. Later the Kenzer skull is stolen from an exhibition during the archaeologists'/ASAA conference. Then the president of ASAA is poisoned. Can Emma and her FBI friend catch the culprits?
